remarks: Fantastic opportunity for developers, investors, or those looking to build in the community of Highlands. This 66' x 130' lot is situated on a tree-lined street and offers a perfect chance to bring your building plans to life. Highlands features many charming character homes, giving the community a distinctive streetscape and established neighbourhood feel. The property is conveniently located just steps from local eateries & treats, parks, schools, trails, and golf, providing easy access to a variety of everyday amenities and recreation. Whether you're looking to build a new home, explore an investment opportunity, or add a project to your portfolio, this well-sized lot offers plenty of potential. Lot value only-home . (id:67522)
